1. Search the Registry of Open Data for candidate datasets.
2. Confirm the best candidates with dataset details or a STAC search.
3. Write the plan: datasets and why, access, processing steps, limitations.

Plan: use Sentinel-2 L2A COGs from Earth Search (sentinel-cogs bucket, us-west-2, no Requester-Pays). Take the three lowest-cloud June 2022 scenes found by search_items, mask clouds with the SCL band, and take a per-pixel median of B02/B03/B04/B08 to build the composite. Limitations: summer haze, tile seams between MGRS tiles.

VERDICT: approve
The datasets and access details match the tool results.
